purpose: Mask-stage constraints for coarse carcinoma interfaces, component topology, encoded protected tissues, and immutable non-tissue; SCC architecture is downstream.

constraints.mask_statement: Change only the declared source label to carcinoma or carcinoma to the declared target; preserve every unrequested semantic label exactly and never reinterpret a coarse label as a finer tissue class.
generation_handoff: Render carcinoma morphology without claiming that coarse Other tissue was specifically stroma, muscle, mucosa, or salivary tissue.
known_limitations: ORCA cannot distinguish non-carcinoma tissue subtypes.

constraints.mask_statement: Use native/auxiliary maps to prohibit overlap with surface epithelium, keratin centers, nerves, and vessels; when visible only on H&E, mask edit cannot guarantee preservation and must abstain on ambiguous overlap.
generation_handoff: Nest/cord cohesion, keratin pearls, satellites, and perineural/vascular relationships must be preserved or rendered downstream and re-audited.
known_limitations: ORCA mask alone cannot encode these structures.

constraints.mask_statement: Start only from an existing carcinoma/non-carcinoma-tissue interface, stay inside the selected band, and reject short/deep or detached edits.
generation_handoff: Use a same-nest/cord/keratinization context for H&E generation.
known_limitations: An ORCA tissue interface is semantically legal but still requires H&E compatibility review.

constraints.mask_statement: Do not create islands, bridge separate carcinoma foci, split a source nest/component, merge targets, or add/fill holes.
known_limitations: True satellite creation or removal requires a dedicated primitive and cannot reuse burden-edit topology rules.
